svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut three lengths of 40 x 40 x 4 angle, 1555 mm on the longest

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge (drawn upright). Cut the lower end 18 degrees off square so

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it stands level when the leg leans 18 degrees in; the upper end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three 11 mm holes in one face of the angle (the flat face), 18 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from its free edge, measured along the leg from the lower end:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: foot pin 19 mm; fin bolts 1453 and 1523 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the three legs clamped together so the holes match.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the flat face lies on a jacket fin (two M10 bolts) and on a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: foot cleat (one M10 bolt, a pin). The other face points away

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: hole centres within 1 mm of the figures.
